messages:
sara: Quick pass on trident-14b (int6) bring-up for GTN. Short summary below.

aj: link to the spreadsheet?

sara: https://rbw.infer/drive/trident-econ (workspace)

sara: TL;DR — unit cost down ~35% vs our baseline 13b-int8 for chat slice, P95 latency roughly the same (~110ms). Long-form QA shows ~1.8% drop on a few slices for >800-token answers.

maria: can you paste the unit econ numbers?

sara: ```
baseline (13b-int8): $0.60 / 1k tokens
trident-14b-int6: $0.39 / 1k tokens
estimated daily savings at 1B tokens/day: ~$210k
```

vikram: where are the regressions concentrated? specific prompts or domains?

sara: mostly legal-summaries and financial-explainers long answers. Small drop in recall/faithfulness on supporting citations, sample-level.

drew: infra note — KV cache hit rate drops ~4% on long contexts; rough ops impact is +1 worker per shard under heavy longform traffic.

aj: product ask: what's a safe rollout plan for GTN?

sara: propose canary plan:
- 5% -> 25% -> 50% over ~2 weeks
Gating metrics:
- composite quality delta >= -1.5% (vs baseline) on core GTN prompt set
- longform rouge-L drop <= 2.5%
- P95 latency within +10ms of baseline
- cost per token target achieved

maria: if we see user-visible regressions, what's the rollback threshold?

vikram: rollback if product metrics (CTR / NPS proxy) drop >1.0% in canary cohort OR quality delta breaches thresholds above. Also automated fallback routing to baseline model when confidence triggers fire.

sara: ops action items:
- @drew estimate infra delta and Dedicated cost for a canary pool
- @aj create canary flags + monitoring dashboards (latency, cost, recall)
- @maria prep comms + gating docs for GTN

drew: I can provision +1 worker per shard for the canary; estimated incremental cost ~ $8k/mo on Dedicated. :thumbsup: 

ops-bot: Canary monitor created: https://rbw.infer/monitor/canary/1735550000 — alerts wired to #eng-oncall and #product on threshold breaches

maria: ack. I’ll draft threshold doc and loop in GTN PMs for the human-eval signoff.

vikram: also recommend parallel small-sample human rating on the legal slice before moving to 25% (500 samples, stratified).

sara: agreed. quick checklist: human eval (500 samples) -> automated eval coverage -> canary ramp.

aj: OK, will schedule kickoff tomorrow and create the runbook. :calendar: 

sara: thanks all. Final recommendation: trident-14b-int6 = recommended for GTN pilot, conditional on the gating plan and a legal-slice human audit. :rocket:
